root_causes: Order worker thread stalled (processed stuck at 14 while enqueued kept growing). The deeper cause is unknown: there were no logs, the config was healthy, and no recent change matches.
evidence: queue_depth rose from 25 to 35 while processed stayed at 14
worker_heartbeat_age_s was 8.3 and heartbeat_age_before_s was 13.2 at restart
Latest change was v1.3 about 26.7h ago, which doesn't match the incident timing
After the restart: processed 86/86, queue_depth 0, check_invariants green
args.impact: The queue backed up to 35 orders (20378.18 SAR total queued per money_impact) and was delayed. No orders were dropped, none were left unpaid, and no ledger issues occurred. All queued orders were processed and paid after the restart.
recommended_actions: Investigate why the worker stalled: add worker-level logging and a processed-count stall alert
args.summary: The queue was backing up because the worker had stalled. I restarted it and it drained the backlog, with all 86 orders paid and invariants green. The root cause of the stall is still unknown, so please follow up.
